songs.title: Whose House (Houston Cougars)
songs.genre: Stadium hype anthem, drumline and marching-band brass, distorted power chords under the chorus, gang vocals, rock-rap verses
songs.extra: Stadium anthem for a 40,000-seat crowd. Big live drumline with tom hits and snare rolls, marching-band brass stabs, distorted guitar power chords under every chorus. Verses: lead rapper rides the beat with hard punchy consonants and confident aggressive swagger. Pre-chorus: rising brass and a snare roll into a hard drop. Chorus: shouted gang vocals, dozens of voices, stadium reverb, crowd stomps and claps on 2 and 4. Chants and call-and-response lines sound like a real crowd through a PA, slightly distant and roomy. Bridge: half-time feel, drums thin out, crowd answers the lead. Final chorus: key up a whole step, full volume. End on a drumline cadence and crowd chant, not a fade. The Whose house / Coogs' house chant is slow and deliberate like a real stadium crowd, two beats on the call, two beats on the answer, three times, The third call and answer is its own held section: the crowd drags every syllable out, roughly twice as long as the first two, like the last line of a stadium chant before kickoff. Pronounce Coogs to rhyme with moves, TDECU as the letters T-D-E-C-U, Yeoman as YO-man. Lines tagged lead rapper alone are one clear voice with no crowd layer, every word intelligible; only the chant sections are crowd vocals.
songs.avoid: slow tempo, ballad feel, acoustic guitar, piano intro, soft or breathy vocals, autotune, trap hi-hat rolls, EDM synth leads, 808 bass as the main bass, mumbled or slurred lyrics, skipping lines, repeating a verse twice, fade-out ending, female lead, child voices, sad or melancholy mood, mentioning any other team or city, altering the lyrics or adding ad-libs that are not written

Houston! (Houston!) Houston! (Houston!)
